source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene expression (PDF 130).

blocks.text: Gene DNA strand par nucleotides ka khaas silsila hai jo polypeptide (protein) banane ki hidayat deta hai. Doosre lafzon mein gene aisa protein ya enzyme bana kar zahir hota hai jo kisi khaas khasiyat ki nashonuma qaboo karta hai. Sab jandar genes zahir karne ka aik hi bunyadi tareeqa use karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Gene apne aap ko kaise 'zahir' karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aisa protein ya enzyme banwa kar jo phir kisi khasiyat ki nashonuma qaboo karta hai.

items: Gene expression: gene ke nucleotides ke silsile se polypeptide banana.
